A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/zone14

Club pays for a coaching tool

zone14Premium

Vienna, Austria · founded 2020 · active · zone14.ai · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolFixed multi-lensNo Italian presence foundEvidence B€500 to €2,000 to start

zone14 rents Austrian built fixed 4K twin camera systems to football clubs on a subscription from EUR 115 to about EUR 130 a month, bundled with its REPLAY analysis software and optional video based player fitness data zone14-01, zone14-02, zone14-03.

For Amateur, semi professional and academy football clubs in German speaking Europe and Croatia that want every home match and training session recorded from a permanent mount and analysed by their own coaches zone14-02, zone14-04. It suits clubs that own or control their ground, since the cameras are mains powered and installed once zone14-02.

zone14 exists because two Viennese founders saw that amateur clubs training four times a week wanted professional style video analysis and that no fixed camera came bundled with the software and the data to do it, so they built the camera, the analysis tool and a video based tracking layer as one subscription zone14-05, zone14-02. It matters now because the Bavarian football association made it official technology partner for more than 4,500 clubs and SK Rapid and Austria Wien's academy use it, which shows a European coaching first alternative to the broadcast and parent led models can reach scale zone14-06, zone14-07. It tells you that in Europe the buyer with the steadiest budget is still the club, and that a vendor that replaces GPS vests with video data has a second reason to be paid.

Price band From EUR 115/month with camera and hardware included (company statement); CORE listed at EUR 130/month, EUR 1,560 billed yearly on the German page after a stated EUR 1,400 sponsorship; ELITE on request; REPLAY software only EUR 20/month zone14-03

Italy zone14 lists Austria, Germany and Croatia as its markets with English, German and Croatian sites, and no Italian club, reseller or pricing was found zone14-07, zone14-01.

The verdict

Look if You are a club in Austria, Germany or Croatia with your own pitch and coaches who will use tagging, drawing and playlists every week, and you want video based distance and sprint data without buying GPS vests zone14-01, zone14-04. You want a fixed system with lifetime hardware upgrades, unlimited downloads and 24/7 WhatsApp support for a monthly fee with no hardware purchase zone14-01.

Skip if You need a portable camera for away games and tournaments, since zone14 TWO is mounted permanently and mains powered zone14-02, zone14-04. You want live distribution to fans or a paywall, because livestreaming is a one click YouTube add on and there is no OTT or monetisation layer zone14-01.

Watch-outs

  • The English pricing page shows CORE and ELITE as price on request while the German page lists CORE at EUR 130 a month, EUR 1,560 billed yearly, described as including EUR 1,400 of sponsorship, so the unsubsidised list price is higher and must be confirmed in writing zone14-01, zone14-03.
  • On the CORE tier recordings become available four hours after the final whistle and are capped at 70 recordings a year, with live availability and unlimited recordings reserved for ELITE zone14-01.
  • 4G connectivity costs extra or requires your own SIM, so a pitch without wired internet adds to the monthly bill zone14-01.
  • zone14 counted over 65 clubs in five countries in May 2024 and over 200 installed systems in Europe by the BFV announcement, so it is a small company whose founders aimed to reach break even in 2025 zone14-05, zone14-06.
  • The website privacy policy covers cookies and the site only, and no public document describes where match video is hosted or how long it is retained beyond the one year minimum zone14-09, zone14-01.

Products

  • zone14 TWO (camera). Two 4K tracking cameras with microphones, 180 degree panorama, mains powered fixed installation, uploads over 4G, WiFi or Ethernet zone14-04.
  • zone14 REPLAY (platform). Web analysis software with drawing, tagging boards, playlists, offline clips, user management and third party footage upload zone14-01.
  • zone14 LIVE (add-on). Live tagging, remote and half time analysis, second screen, precision replay and YouTube livestreaming zone14-01.
  • zone14 STATS (add-on). Video based player tracking producing distance, sprints, high intensity runs and running maps without wearables zone14-01, zone14-04.
  • TRAIN and Goal Cam (add-on). Training session recording with multiple balls and an additional goal camera, listed for ELITE zone14-03.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
zone14 is a coaching first product for football clubs at every level, with SK Rapid using it on training pitches, FK Austria Wien's sports science team and regional league clubs such as Wiener Sport Club and SV Lafnitz as testimonials zone14-01, zone14-02. Training recording with multiple balls is supported on ELITE, which is unusual and useful for academies zone14-01. It is a match and training analysis tool with no fan facing layer.
Capture quality
zone14 TWO uses two 4K tracking cameras with integrated microphones to produce a 180 degree panoramic view of the pitch, mounted once and connected to mains power zone14-04, zone14-01. Frame rate, sensor and low light figures are not published, so ask for sample footage from an evening match under floodlights.
Automation accuracy
The AI follows play automatically so no camera operator is needed, and zone14 STATS derives per player tracking from the same video to produce distance, sprints and high intensity runs zone14-04, zone14-01. No independent accuracy benchmark exists for either the framing or the fitness data, and the fitness metrics should be validated against GPS on a few sessions before replacing vests.
Multi-angle and stitching
Two cameras are stitched into a single panoramic recording from which the tracked view is cut, and a Goal Cam add on is listed for ELITE zone14-04, zone14-01. There is no multi position camera coverage beyond that.
Latency and live readiness
Live features are add ons or ELITE inclusions: live tagging synced after the match, remote analysis during the game, second screen access to REPLAY, precision replay of each scene, half time analysis and one click YouTube livestreaming zone14-01. On CORE the recording is available four hours after the match zone14-01. Stream latency is not published.
Reliability and resilience
The system is mains powered with no charging, installed once with no regular maintenance, uploads automatically after the final whistle and includes a camera status checker and lifetime hardware upgrades zone14-01, zone14-04. Recordings are stored for at least one year zone14-01. No public complaint history was found, and the customer base is small enough that none should be expected.
Portability and install
Installation is a one time job of 20 to 40 minutes with a mounting plate, a few screws and a connection box, supported by zone14's team, and a suitability check for the venue is offered before ordering zone14-01, zone14-04. The camera does not travel, so away matches need a second solution.
Connectivity and bandwidth
Uploads run over 4G, WiFi or Ethernet, with 4G offered for an additional charge or through the club's own SIM zone14-04, zone14-01. Bandwidth requirements are not published.
Workflow and UX
Matches are scheduled online by team, venue and time and the cameras record and upload without anyone present, then coaches work in REPLAY with drawing tools, saved drawings on the timeline, customisable and multiple tagging boards, cross match playlists, offline clips, playback speed control and user management zone14-04, zone14-01. Support runs through a WhatsApp group with the zone14 team on CORE and above zone14-01.
Analysis layer
REPLAY is a full amateur analysis suite with unlimited tags and playlists, and STATS adds video derived fitness data with visualisations as an add on, included in ELITE zone14-01. A COACH product and an AI as a service offer are listed in the site navigation without public detail zone14-01. This is the deepest analysis layer among the five vendors in this batch.
Integrations
Third party footage can be uploaded to REPLAY on the EUR 20 tier or as an add on, and livestreams go to YouTube zone14-01. No API, federation database link or export to other analysis platforms is documented.
Distribution and OTT
Distribution is limited to one click YouTube livestreaming as an add on and clip downloads for social media zone14-01. There is no white label platform, paywall or advertising layer.
Data access and ownership
Full match downloads and clip downloads are unlimited on the camera tiers and recordings are kept for a minimum of one year zone14-01. Terms on ownership after cancellation and on hosting location are not published zone14-09.
Privacy and compliance
zone14 GmbH is an Austrian company subject to GDPR and its imprint lists the register number and managing directors zone14-10. The public privacy policy addresses the website only and no blurring, opt out or minors policy is documented for match footage, so clubs filming youth teams need their own consent process zone14-09. Footage stays within the club's REPLAY account and never reaches a public platform, which limits exposure compared with broadcast models zone14-01.
Security
Not assessable from public sources.
Pricing and TCO
zone14 states the system starts at EUR 115 a month including the camera and all hardware, the German page lists CORE at EUR 130 a month or EUR 1,560 a year after a stated EUR 1,400 sponsorship, REPLAY software alone costs EUR 20 a month and ELITE is on request zone14-03, zone14-01. A 2024 report put packages at EUR 115 to 165 a month zone14-05. There is no upfront hardware purchase, a one month trial with full refund and lifetime hardware upgrades, so three year cost on CORE is about EUR 4,680 plus any 4G charge zone14-01.
Support and service
Email support on REPLAY and 24/7 WhatsApp group support on CORE and ELITE, plus installation assistance and a camera status checker zone14-01. Support languages follow the German, English and Croatian sites zone14-01.
Company health and roadmap
zone14 GmbH, founded in 2020 in Vienna by Simon Schmiderer, Lukas Grömer and Tobias Gahleitner, closed a six figure round with FFG grant support in May 2024 from Runtastic founders Alfred Luger and Christian Kaar, Tractive's Wolfgang Reisinger and others, and added former Austria Wien captain Manuel Ortlechner as investor in June 2026 for international expansion zone14-05, zone14-07. The 2024 plan targeted cost neutral operation in 2025 and a later growth round zone14-05. Financials are not public.
Evidence and references
SK Rapid Vienna, FK Austria Wien sports science, Austria Wien academy, Wiener Sport Club, SV Lafnitz and TSU Hafnerbach appear as named users, and the Bavarian football association BFV is official technology partner with exclusive conditions for its 4,500 plus clubs zone14-01, zone14-06, zone14-07. zone14 reported over 200 installed systems across Europe at the BFV announcement zone14-06.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Testimonials from a Bundesliga head of sports science and regional league head coaches describe hours saved each week and analysis of key scenes in minutes zone14-01. No independent review site coverage exists, so satisfaction evidence is vendor curated.
Edge versus cloud
Cameras record locally and upload to the zone14 REPLAY server after the match, with analysis and STATS processing in the cloud, and CORE footage ready after four hours zone14-04, zone14-01. Server location is not published zone14-09.
Accessibility and languages
Website and product in English, German and Croatian, and REPLAY lists multiple language support zone14-01. Accessibility features are not documented.
Upgrade path
Clubs start with REPLAY on their own footage at EUR 20 a month, move to CORE for the camera system and to ELITE for live features, STATS, training recording and Goal Cam, with LIVE and STATS available as add ons on CORE zone14-01. Hardware upgrades are included for the life of the subscription zone14-01.
Differentiators worth testing
Test STATS distance and sprint figures against a GPS vest on the same players for three sessions, because replacing trackers is the pitch zone14-04. Test training recording with several balls in play on the ELITE tier zone14-01. Confirm the unsubsidised CORE price and the 4G surcharge in writing given the sponsorship wording on the German page zone14-03.

Company

Ownership and funding zone14 GmbH, FN 562823 g, Vienna, is led by managing directors Simon Schmiderer and Lukas Grömer zone14-10. Investors include Runtastic co founders Alfred Luger and Christian Kaar, Silke Greiner, Christian Kranebitter, Tim Moser, Philipp Omenitsch and Wolfgang Reisinger after a six figure round with FFG support in May 2024, and Manuel Ortlechner joined as investor in June 2026 zone14-05, zone14-07. Round sizes beyond six figures are not disclosed.

Financials not public

Scale, company-stated Over 65 clubs in five countries, May 2024 zone14-05; over 200 installed systems across Europe at the BFV partnership announcement zone14-06; markets Austria, Germany and Croatia, June 2026 zone14-07.
